name: servosity-mcp
description: The first MSP-fleet CLI for backup. Every Servosity API endpoint as a typed command, plus a local mirror that lets you ask questions the dashboard can't — across your whole book of clients.

servosity_msp_token.title: SERVOSITY_MSP_TOKEN
servosity_msp_token.description: Sets SERVOSITY_MSP_TOKEN for the Servosity MCP server.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile
printing_press_client_profile.description: Binds this MCP server to one tenant-gated client profile, so every call answers for that customer. Leave blank to use the profile configured as default_client_profile.

servosity_msp_base_url.title: Servosity API base URL
servosity_msp_base_url.description: Base URL for the Servosity API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

servosity_msp_reseller_id.title: Reseller ID
servosity_msp_reseller_id.description: Numeric reseller ID from the partner portal, used to scope reseller reports. Leave blank to let the CLI probe for it from your account.

servosity_msp_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
servosity_msp_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Servosity requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.
